scores.notes: Alice beside the mushroom and in the courtroom has light brown shoulder-length hair, fair rosy skin, a small pointed chin and similar young facial features. Her differing scale does not conflict with those cues.
The floating head and the cat on the branch share gray tabby forehead stripes, pale muzzle, pink nose, pointed ears and yellow-green eyes with an exaggerated toothy grin.
The bottle-drinking and seated Alice share golden-brown shoulder-length hair, fair skin, a small nose and a youthful oval face. The swept hair and indignant expression do not obscure the resemblance.
Alice at tea and drinking from the bottle has the same wavy golden-brown hair, rosy fair cheeks, small nose and young rounded face.

Alice at tea and by the Caterpillar has matching light brown hair, fair skin, a small pointed chin and youthful facial proportions. The hair lies straighter in the woodland view but remains compatible in length and colour.

Both show a daylight croquet lawn scored with parallel furrows, clipped hedges and upright narrow trees, with card-shaped arches. The brick wall visible beyond the left hedges is compatible with the hedged enclosure on the right.
The Hatter at tea has gray hair swept around the ears and a deeply lined older face. The courtroom Hatter has much darker brown hair and a younger, smoother narrow face.

Both show a cloth-covered tea table beneath a broad gnarled tree, with an ivy-covered steep-gabled brick house and leaded windows behind. The closer, shaded left viewpoint is compatible with the wider garden view.
The courtroom Hatter has long straw-brown wispy hair and a long drooping oval face; the tea-table Hatter has shorter dark gray waves and a sharply hooked nose with a more angular lined face.

Alice holding the flamingo and standing by the mushroom has the same wavy light brown hair, fair rosy skin, small nose and youthful facial shape. The dress details change, but the visible identity cues agree.

Both have a long cloth-covered table on grass beneath a large spreading tree, next to an ivy-clad house with diamond-pane windows. The different view reveals timberwork on a compatible side of the house.

Alice on the lawn and in court shares shoulder-length golden-brown waves, fair skin, a small nose and youthful pointed chin. The courtroom distance changes her apparent size without conflicting facial cues.

Behind the left table is an ivy-covered red brick house with steep front gables and diamond-pane windows. The right has a plain pale symmetrical facade, rectangular sash-like windows and a low hipped roof, a conflicting building.
The bottle-drinking girl and Alice by the Caterpillar share wavy light brown hair, a fair youthful oval face, small nose and similar slender proportions.

Alice in both images has light golden-brown hair reaching the shoulders, fair rosy skin, large light eyes and a small chin. The hair blowing outward and changed scale do not supply a clear conflicting identity cue.

Both show a large spreading tree beside a long wooden tea table on a grassy clearing, with a steep-roofed cottage and surrounding woods. The closer right view's leaded windows and upper timberwork are compatible with another face of the cottage.
Alice holding the flamingo and Alice in the armchair share a dark hairband, shoulder-length light brown waves, fair skin and the same small-nosed youthful face.

The courtroom Alice and seated Alice have matching golden-brown shoulder-length hair, fair youthful faces, small noses and pointed chins; distance and posture account for their different apparent sizes.

Both views show a sunlit enclosed croquet lawn with rough furrowed grass, clipped hedges, tall trees and card arches. The tall hedge and gateway on the left can occupy another side from the visible brick wall on the right.

Alice in court and holding the flamingo has matching light brown wavy hair, fair rosy cheeks, small nose and young oval face. Her pose and apparent scale differ without changing recognizable identity.

Both are daylight croquet lawns bordered by clipped greenery and tall trees, with scattered arches and uneven grass. The right view can show a less deeply furrowed area nearer the flowered brick boundary.
The flamingo-holder and bottle-drinker share golden-brown shoulder-length waves, fair skin, large light eyes and a small youthful nose and chin.
Alice in court and beside the mushroom has matching light brown waves, fair oval face, small nose and youthful slender build. The different dress trim does not change those identity cues.

Both show an uneven grassy croquet enclosure in daylight, with clipped hedges, tall trees and small red-patterned arches. The brick wall exposed on the left is compatible with a different boundary from the taller hedges on the right.

Alice beside the Caterpillar and holding the flamingo shares fair rosy skin, light brown shoulder-length hair, small nose and youthful pointed chin. The different hair sweep and scale leave those recognizable cues intact.
The bottle-drinker and croquet player have matching wavy golden-brown hair, rosy fair faces, small noses and youthful builds.
The house behind the left tea table has steep projecting gables, ivy and leaded cottage windows. On the right it becomes a pale symmetrical house with a low hipped roof and plain rectangular windows.
Alice in the armchair and with the flamingo has the same golden-brown waves, fair rosy cheeks and youthful small-nosed face; bending forward changes her expression and silhouette.

Both views place a tea table beneath a broad leafy tree in front of a reddish brick, steep-gabled cottage. The smaller oblique house view on the left is compatible with the closer ivy-covered facade on the right.

Alice in the hall and courtroom has matching wavy golden-brown hair, pale oval face, small nose and young facial proportions. The wider courtroom view reduces her apparent size without changing identity cues.

Both show a daylight lawn with uneven ridges, small croquet arches, clipped shrubs, pale brick boundary walls and tall trees beyond. The closer right view remains compatible with the wider left garden.
Both have grassy croquet grounds enclosed by pinkish brick walls, clipped greenery and tall narrow trees, in warm daylight. Different amounts of furrowing can belong to different parts of this lawn.
Alice beside the mushroom and Alice at tea shares golden-brown wavy hair, fair rosy skin, large light eyes and a small youthful oval face.
The seated and courtroom Alice have matching wavy golden-brown hair, fair cheeks, a small nose and young facial proportions. Her posture and distance change without a conflicting identity cue.

The cat on the branch and the floating head share gray tabby stripes, a pale muzzle, pink triangular nose, pointed ears and yellow-green eyes. The wider eyes versus narrowed smiling eyes are an expression change.

Alice in court and drinking from the bottle has matching golden-brown shoulder-length hair, fair skin and a youthful small-nosed face. The different scale and swept hair do not change recognizable identity.
